CREATE TABLE "vod_m3useriesrelation" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "external_series_id" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "custom_properties" text NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("custom_properties") OR "custom_properties" IS NULL)), "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "last_episode_refresh" datetime NULL, "m3u_account_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "m3u_m3uaccount" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "series_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "vod_series" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "category_id" bigint NULL REFERENCES "vod_vodcategory" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "last_seen" datetime NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE "vod_m3uvodcategoryrelation" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "enabled" bool NOT NULL, "custom_properties" text NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("custom_properties") OR "custom_properties" IS NULL)), "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "m3u_account_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "m3u_m3uaccount" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "category_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "vod_vodcategory" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

CREATE TABLE "vod_movie" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "uuid" char(32) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "description" text NULL, "year" integer NULL, "rating" varchar(10) NULL, "genre" varchar(255) NULL, "duration_secs" integer NULL, "imdb_id" varchar(50) NULL, "custom_properties" text NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("custom_properties") OR "custom_properties" IS NULL)), "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "logo_id" bigint NULL REFERENCES "vod_vodlogo" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "is_adult" bool NOT NULL, "language" varchar(2) NOT NULL, "tmdb_id" varchar(50) NULL)

CREATE TABLE "vod_series" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "uuid" char(32) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "description" text NULL, "year" integer NULL, "rating" varchar(10) NULL, "genre" varchar(255) NULL, "imdb_id" varchar(50) NULL, "custom_properties" text NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("custom_properties") OR "custom_properties" IS NULL)), "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "logo_id" bigint NULL REFERENCES "vod_vodlogo" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "language" varchar(2) NOT NULL, "tmdb_id" varchar(50) NULL)

CREATE TABLE "vod_vodcategory" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "category_type" varchar(10) NOT NULL, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE "vod_vodlogo" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "url" text NOT NULL UNIQUE)
